title: The Vegetarian
author: Han Kang
summary: After a disturbing dream, a quiet South Korean woman stops eating meat, and her family reacts with growing force. The story is told in three parts by her husband, her brother-in-law and her sister, never by her.
readIf: you like spare, unsettling literary fiction that raises questions without explaining them.
skipIf: you want a clear plot or sympathetic explanations, or you would find the family violence and assault upsetting.

pairings.reason: Another short Asian novel about a woman who refuses social expectations, though with far more humour.
A short, strange story of a person changing and a family that cannot cope with it.
A cool, bleak study of a woman withdrawing from the world on her own terms.
